title: Odd vs even XOR-ring classical Phi growth exponents: point estimates differ (|db|=0.71) but UNDERPOWERED/not distinguishable (revised C4060 per Whisper F72). Amplitude split IS solid.
method: log-log OLS on existing tractable series (ZERO new PyPhi/QPU). Resolves Exp76 P4 + informs pred_c4010_001.

excluded.reason: log(0) undefined; Phi(4)=0. NOTE (C4060): this is the ONLY zero in tractable range -- N=8 (also N mod4==0) is Phi=7.5, NOT zero. So the earlier gloss (all-ones reachable when N mod4==0) is FALSIFIED; N=4=0 is a single small-N boundary artifact, not a modular family of zeros.

verdict: UNRESOLVED/UNDERPOWERED (revised C4060 per Whisper F72): point estimate leans rates-differ (|db|=0.71) but NOT significant -- interaction t=2.41/df=3/p=0.095, Welch p=0.151. Original 2.64sigma used naive Gaussian reference (wrong df). SOLID: amplitude/intercept split (parity_shift t=-6.6, p=0.007).
caveats: b_even rests on only 3 points (N=6,8,10); N=4 excluded as structural zero
2.64sigma is moderate not decisive; a 4th even point (N=12, intractable per F60) would firm this
The PARITY DISCRIMINATOR itself (c4022_001: odd high / even low Phi at fixed N) is NOT challenged; only the same-growth-RATE assumption (F52/Exp76 P4) is falsified

DEEPEST: even series model-misspecified -- no a*N^b fits Phi(4)=0; b_even is a boundary-inflated local slope and drives the entire db. Only the point-estimate comparison (P4) is faithful; asymptotic reading is not.
implication: Under F52 power-law form the fitted exponents differ. NOT supported: even-grows-faster-asymptotically / gap-narrows / crossover ~N=247 -- WITHDRAWN (advisor C4059): even series is not a power law (Phi(4)=0 structural zero), b_even is a local slope near that zero, misspecification artifact.
